methods.description: Multiply by10/100 using placevalue, also within benchmark shortcuts.
Multiply by25 as one quarter of multiplication by100.
Double one factor and halve the other to preserve a useful product.
Divide by a power-of-two divisor using repeated whole-number halvings.
Multiply convenient placevalue parts and add the partial products.
Use a reliable written two-digit multiplication method and retain tens-place partialproducts.
Multiply by a nearby easy number then subtract the extra groups.
Double dividend and divisor to change division by5 into division by10.
Split a dividend into convenient multiples of its divisor and combine quotients.
Multiply dividend and divisor by4 to change division by25 into division by100.
